next_action.rationale: Root cause fully established with discriminating evidence: allocation rule v18 routes split-reservation orders to carrier partition 2, whose pickup-window feed consumer broke at 05:58, creating 47-minute data staleness that exceeds the 30-minute slot window. This mechanism causes 186 orders (scope EXC-0921) to remain permanently held. Prevention mitigation: rule v18 reverted to v17 to stop new allocations. Remediation path: Carrier Ops must restart partition 2's consumer, re-correct pickup slots for EXC-0921, then replay allocations. Assessment complete; incident escalated to Carrier Operations.
